scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-shared build && pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-server build && pnpm --filter bigquery-emulator build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-shared test && pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-server test && pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-test test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-shared lint && pnpm --filter @bigquery-emulator/vscode-server lint && pnpm --filter bigquery-emulator lint
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter bigquery-emulator package
